text:
Maya (CSM): Flagging KryptonWare renewal ~5w out. Noticed sharp drop: ~52% DAU decline last month. Seats active down. They also started a "quiet" procurement eval with a competitor (NebulaAI) per a note from AE. Need quick triage.
Jordan (AM): Yikes. Any product alerts? billing hits?
Maya (CSM): No billing spikes. Recent change: they rotated API keys 2024-11-02 and turned on a custom routing layer. Could be misconfig.
Devon (Solutions Eng): I dug into logs for their prod key. Seeing spikes of 502 + longer tail latency on embed routes after the rotation. Example: ```2024-11-03T14:12:09Z ERROR 502 gateway timeout route=/embed user=krypton-01```
Luca (AE): I'll loop in the buyer. Quick question: any evidence they started moving traffic to NebulaAI?
Jordan (AM): Procurement pinged us last week about contract benchmarks. No firm cutover.
Maya (CSM): Also observed: their platform team paused background batch jobs (likely to save cost). Correlates with rerank usage drop.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Hypothesis: key rotation + custom routing + paused batches => higher on-demand tokens, hitting transient concurrency limits. Short-term mitigation: enable prefix KV cache + raise concurrency for their account to 1.5x for 72h.
Luca (AE): Can we offer a 2-week Dedicated trial or consumption credit to match Nebula's PO? That could stall the eval.
Ana (Sales Exec): We can approve a short trial but want engineering validation first. Also: what's the lift to enable cache + concurrency?
Devon (Solutions Eng): Low lift. I can push a scoped account override:```json
{"account_overrides": {"krypton": {"kv_cache": "prefix_on", "concurrency_limit": "1.5"}}}
```
I'll run smoke tests after deploy.
Maya (CSM): Nice. Let's also prepare a short one-pager showing latency/cost delta vs NebulaAI focusing on their top 5 routes. We need to convert technical regain into procurement value.
Jordan (AM): I'll pull usage heatmap + seat cohort list and share by EOD + note inactive seats.
Luca (AE): I'll draft the trial offer and procurement-friendly comparison slide (cost per 1k tokens, avg latencies, model compatibility).
OpsBot: Reminder: Renewal calendar event for KryptonWare on 2025-01-01 needs executive confirmation.
Maya (CSM): Please schedule a 30m revive call fast: Priya (Dir Data), Evan (Procure), their Eng lead Sam, and Ana. Goal: demo mitigations + confirm signal for renewal.
Ana (Sales Exec): Available Wed 2024-11-13 10:00 PT. If they push back, book the 13:30 backup.
Devon (Solutions Eng): I'll deploy the override to staging now and then to prod after quick test. Post-deploy validation: run 100 embeds + check tail latency < 500ms.
Maya (CSM): Good. Also capture feedback: they reported a drop in result quality after a framework upgrade last month. Could be model mismatch. Add regression test vs their golden set.
Jordan (AM): Uploading exports: https://redwood.example.com/internal/exports/kryptonware_1745554321_usage.csv (internal). Includes seat churn and top routes.
Luca (AE): Added proposed offer to Google Drive and invited procurement contacts. Will present a short comparative slide.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Staging pass looks good. Prod push scheduled in 30m. Curl for smoke: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer prod-krypton" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/embed -d '{"input":"test"}'```
Maya (CSM): Action items recap: Jordan - heatmap & seat list (EOD). Devon - deploy override + regression run (24h). Luca - finalize trial + slide (48h). Maya - draft invite + call agenda and chase Priya. Escalation: if no reply in 72h, escalate to RevOps for an executive touch.
Jordan (AM): Done. Heatmap uploaded and private link posted.
Maya (CSM): Thanks. I'll ping Priya and Evan now.
Luca (AE): :thumbsup: Will follow up with procurement.
Ana (Sales Exec): Keep me posted. If we see no engagement, open account-level exec escalation.
Maya (CSM): Noted. Reconvene after prod validation and before the call.
Luca (AE): Thanks all. :rocket:
